notes: LOCKED: the 'Changes' tab (data-cd-id="changes", data-cd-locked) is left untouched, so the Changes / History tab bar keeps the v1 .tabbar/.tab classes. maude-v2 has no .tab; its Tabs are .seg with aria-pressed. Converting the tab bar needs that tab unlocked (⇧⌘L); until then the tabs are styled only by GitPanel.css .gp-tabs.

Callouts (.callout--info on the Get-latest nudge, .callout--warn on 'Publish didn't go through') keep their classes. maude-v2's .callout has no tone variants, so they render as quiet neutral callouts with no status-hue bar. Decide: accept quiet, or add a local tone in GitPanel.css.
Theme: kept data-theme="dark". maude-v2 is light-first ('Light glass'); switching the artboards to light is one word per wrapper if wanted.
Look shifts that come from the tokens alone: accent goes indigo (hue 268) → azure (238), radii grow (sm 5→6, md 7→10, lg 10→14 px), fonts go Inter/JetBrains Mono → system UI / SF Mono.

Words: maude-v2 CONTRACT §3 says 'Share' (not Publish) and 'Version history' (not History), and the collaborators are Tereza and Jonas (not Anna). The brief calls this vocabulary load-bearing, so copy is not changed here — needs a decision.
The inline Maude mark is the v1 spark-on-bubble; maude-v2 keeps its own mark in system/maude-v2/preview/logo. Not redrawn here.
Prose comments in the file header and GitPanel.css still say 'maude DS'; harmless, can be tidied after the switch.
